_meta.description: Config SSOT for the enviroplus backup lane. Two sources with different shapes: enviro.db is a single live SQLite file needing a consistent snapshot, raw-capture is an append-only tree of immutable per-day files. They replicate by different verbs for that reason, not by preference.
principles: Verification is by remote hash, never by exit code. rclone exiting 0 is not evidence the bytes arrived.
No enumerated backup target list: sources are declared here as a set, and a new source is a new entry rather than an edit to code.
Timeouts are off-nominal guards sized so a nominal run never reaches them.
A run that cannot prove what landed fails loud and leaves no manifest.

database.comment: VACUUM INTO, never a file copy. The database is journal_mode=WAL with four concurrent writers; a naive copy is torn and its hash would certify the torn artifact.

raw_capture.comment: Canonical tier. Immutable per-day files, so sync transfers only new days; a tarball would re-upload the whole corpus every run.

local_staging.comment: Snapshots are staged locally so the uploaded artifact is the one whose hash was computed. Retention is a working-set bound, not the backup horizon -- the remote holds history.
